summary: Dirt apron at the mouth of a powerline easement track off the road.
reasons: Houses and farm across the road

drivers.seclusion: Bush and the easement behind; houses and sheds sit 40-100 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare dirt apron meets the road, but it is the entry to a pylon access track, not a separate pull-in.
drivers.traffic: Fast rural road beside the apron; passing drivers would not mind a parked van.
drivers.convention: No vehicles, tyre tracks beyond the track or camping signs seen.

flags: Powerline easement track, likely gated or closed to the public
Steep ground in the DEM, up to 40% on the bank behind
Nerang River 83 m away, elevation about 45 m
sun_shade: Open to sun with bush on the south-west side; no overhead cover.
cannot_judge: Whether a gate stands at the track mouth
